div.div:
fabric_addr_map (soc_bus_pkg::xbar_rule_t, 48-bit):
[0] RAM: RamBaseAddr .. +RamSize (0x80000000)
[1] UART: UartBaseAddr .. +UartSize (0x10000000)
[2] DEBUG: DebugBaseAddr .. +DebugSize (e.g. 0x00000000 in ROM-select)
[3] CLINT: ClintBaseAddr .. +ClintSize (0x02000000)
[4] DMA: DmaBaseAddr .. +DmaSize (0x01000000)
[5] PLIC: PlicBaseAddr .. +PlicSize (0x0C000000)
decode miss -> built-in error slave (DECERR)

div.div:
AXI protocol checkers (sim only):
- one soc_axi_protocol_checker on each core_axi_req[i] (xbar slave ports)
- one on each target_axi_req[i] (xbar master ports)
Single-beat invariants: len == 0, w.last == 1, payload stable while valid && !ready.
CVA6 mode (CoreType = platform_pkg::CoreCva6): replaces RV32 instr/data OBI bridges with corejack_cva6_axi_adapter; AXI[1] is tied to '0 (no second initiator).

div.div: RAM-window traffic never enters the xbar: the RV32 request routers, CVA6's axi_demux and the iDMA each drive their own soc_mem_ss ports (bottom rows). The xbar's RAM target (port[0] -> soc_mem_ss ports 0/1) serves debug SBA and any other fabric-routed RAM access. The iDMA is not an xbar initiator; only its CSR leg (xbar port[4] -> soc_axi_to_apb) uses the fabric.
